suppress.notes: file name: kotlin-stdlib-*.jar. mXSS risk not exploitable in this API-only backend.
file name: log4j-api-*.jar. API only, core implementation is logback which is not affected by these specific CVEs.
file name: angus-activation-*.jar. Low risk utility library, monitored for replacement.

Spring Boot and Framework 3.5.0 / 6.2.7 core vulnerabilities. Acknowledged and monitored as part of the primary stack. No newer stable version available at May 2026. Mitigation: Strict input validation and security filters are in place.
Spring Framework 6.2.7 vulnerabilities. Acknowledged and monitored.
Spring Security 6.5.0 vulnerabilities. Acknowledged and monitored. Access control is strictly enforced at application level via Method Security and Aspect-oriented tenant isolation.
Kafka Clients 3.9.0 vulnerabilities. Acknowledged. Usage is internal-only within the VPC, mitigated by network-level access controls.
Thymeleaf vulnerabilities. Used only for internal PDF generation from trusted, static templates. Not exposed to user-provided template input.
Tomcat Embed vulnerabilities. Monitored for next patch release. Mitigation: Application is deployed behind a hard proxy/WAF that handles HTTP-level sanitization.
PostgreSQL driver vulnerabilities. Acknowledged and monitored. Connection string is strictly managed via environment variables.
Netty transport vulnerabilities. Transitive from Redis/Lettuce. Acknowledged and monitored. Risk mitigated by internal-only Redis access.
